title: Nightly Valet Saving by Ashbury Rewards Elite Tier on Guest Folios
content:
Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite members receive a nightly valet saving on Guest Folios set by their tier.

**Terms.** Valet saving method: for an Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite member the nightly valet saving is the full valet upgrade, the brand's valet rate less the brand's self-parking rate; for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member it is the valet upgrade times the Titanium upgrade share of 0.5 (one half); for an Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite member it is the Platinum valet saving percent of 8% of the brand's valet rate; for every other member it is the member valet saving percent of the brand's valet rate.

The valet upgrade is the difference between the brand's valet rate and the brand's self-parking rate per night parked. The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Nightly valet saving |
|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | The full valet upgrade: the brand's valet rate less the brand's self-parking rate |
| Titanium Elite | The valet upgrade times 0.5 |
| Platinum Elite | 8% of the brand's valet rate |
| Any other tier | The member valet saving percent of the brand's valet rate |

## Worked figures (hypothetical brand rates)

Hypothetical brand: valet rate $60.00 a night, self-parking rate $40.00 a night, so a valet upgrade of $20.00.

| Tier | Nightly valet saving |
|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | $20.00 |
| Titanium Elite | $10.00 ($20.00 times 0.5) |
| Platinum Elite | $4.80 (8% of $60.00) |

Hypothetical brand with no self-parking charge: valet rate $70.00 and self-parking rate $0.00. The valet upgrade is the whole $70.00, so the Ambassador Elite nightly saving is $70.00 and the Titanium Elite nightly saving $35.00.
